design_philosophy: Cinematic Awwwards-level medical website & private clinical portal. Inspired by fireguard.org (momentum smooth scrolling, line-by-line kinetic typography reveals, sticky pinned sections, deep high-contrast navy surfaces, bold pulse accents).

typography.headline_font: Outfit / Plus Jakarta Sans (bold, kinetic, tracking-tight)
typography.mono_font: JetBrains Mono (for medical stats, EKG telemetry, timestamps)

sizes.hero_h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-extrabold tracking-tight leading-none

motion_and_animations.smooth_scroll: Lenis smooth scroll integration on public landing page for momentum feel
motion_and_animations.hero_animations: Line-by-line animated text mask reveal for headline 'Tu corazón merece cuidado antes del síntoma'. Concentric pulse ring animation around Dr. Julio Cascante cutout photo.
motion_and_animations.scroll_reveals: Framer motion scroll-triggered line reveals, staggered service card entries, sticky pinned sections during process walkthrough
motion_and_animations.micro_interactions: Subtle scale up and glow on CTA buttons, hover state contrast lifts, spring animations on floating WhatsApp FAB button

layout_and_grid.landing_hero: Split flex/grid layout on dark navy background (#070E20) featuring high-resolution transparent Dr. Julio Cascante cutout, animated floating service badges, stat counters, and prominent 'Agendar Cita' WhatsApp CTA
layout_and_grid.services_grid: 3-column responsive bento or 6-card grid on light background with central treadmill/ergometry visual anchor
layout_and_grid.about_split: Doctor portrait in suit + credentials checklist, medical trajectory stats (+15 años de experiencia, 6 estudios especializados, 100% enfoque preventivo)
layout_and_grid.testimonials: 3 dark or light elevated cards with patient stories, quote marks, and verified patient tags
layout_and_grid.contact: Deep navy contact section with interactive appointment request form + direct phone/WhatsApp info
layout_and_grid.dashboard_layout: Dark clinical interface with persistent header (JC brand logo, Doctor profile dropdown, Logout), main tab navigation (Gestionar Casos, Pacientes, Diapositivas), patient filter bar, and data table
layout_and_grid.case_presentation_card: Dark near-black rounded card (#0A0F1D) with pink/magenta heading accents, cyan telemetry labels, 4-quadrant layout: Cuadro Clínico, EKG Image Gallery, Laboratorios list, Ecocardiogram video player with measurements text overlay
layout_and_grid.slideshow_viewer: White slide presentation canvas contained inside dark navy container with yellow action toolbar: Atrás, Fullscreen, Compartir, Descargar, Siguiente, + Subir PPTX/PDF dropzone

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure the header navigation is NEVER transparent when scrolled over content; use backdrop-blur glassmorphism (e.g., bg-[#070E20]/80 backdrop-blur-md) with border-b border-white/10.
All key interactive elements MUST include data-testid attributes (e.g. data-testid='login-button', data-testid='tab-gestionar-casos', data-testid='whatsapp-cta', data-testid='patient-selector').
The codebase uses React JS files (.js / .jsx), NOT TypeScript files (.tsx).
Implement Lenis or smooth scroll hooks alongside Framer Motion line-by-line reveals for fireguard.org style storytelling.
Dashboard must support switching between 'Gestionar Casos', 'Pacientes', and 'Diapositivas'.
Case presentation view must render dark card mockup style with cyan (#38BDF8) and magenta (#EC4899) section tags, video player for ecocardiograma, image modal/viewer for EKG, and labs status.
Slideshow viewer must display slide deck preview, allow PPTX/PDF upload, full screen mode, and download actions with yellow (#FACC15) interactive toolbar controls.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Avoid default Vercel or generic Bootstrap looks. Embrace bold kinetic typography and rich deep navy gradients.
Never use dark colors as standard flat gradients; use layered dark surfaces with crisp 1px borders (border-white/10).
Never center-align whole body sections. Use strong asymmetric layouts with clear optical hierarchy.
Ensure text contrast ratios meet WCAG AA standards in both dark hero/dashboard surfaces and light testimonial/services sections.
Add hover states explicitly specifying hover text color along with hover background color.
